component.name: Autai
component.summary: Free web research and an AI editor for the books you read
调研免费，把水拧干，把故事留下

description.p: Two jobs in one app: research the web for free, and put an AI editor between you and the rough draft of the books you read.
一个应用干两件事：免费把资料查穿，把书脱水。追的书先过一位 AI 编辑——拧干水分、留下故事，再送到你手上。

Research comes in three depths from one command bar: a quick pass when you just need a fact, a standard search when you want a solid answer with sources, and Deep Research when the question deserves a real report. Deep Research decomposes the question into subtopics, then plans, searches, and reads across the open web and writes the whole thing up as a structured report with references. The searching is free: Autai drives a real browser straight to Google and Bing — no search API keys, no per-query fees. The only meter running is the model you already brought a key for.
查资料：不收搜索费，查得深还能出报告。一个命令栏三档力度：要个事实快速搜一下，要个靠谱答案走标准搜索、带来源，问题值得认真对待就上深度调研。深度调研先把问题拆成子问题，分头去搜、挨个点开读，线索追到底，最后攒成一篇带引用的完整报告。搜索全程免费：它自己开浏览器去 Google、Bing 翻，不走搜索 API、不按次计费，你只花本来就该花的模型 token——Key 还是你自己的。

Story Mode is an AI editor for web serials and fan translations. Cut the word count and keep the story: the plot, characters, payoffs, and foreshadowing stay exactly where the author left them. Fix grammar and the clichés every serial leans on, or expand flat scenes into set pieces without padding. It reads fiction from any language, follows custom instructions like keeping poems in verse, and takes a book from anywhere: a local file, a link, or just a title it goes and finds online. The built-in reader has eleven themes, typography controls, a table of contents, bookmarks, and it remembers where you stopped.

故事模式是给网文和翻译稿拧水分的 AI 编辑：复述上一章、设定第三次讲解、围观群众集体震惊这些水文套路，内置 85 种脱水情景——章内 51 种、跨章并写 34 种——统统压掉；一个旋钮选力度，从「轻扫一下」到「别废话推剧情」，人物、爽点、伏笔一个不动。文笔顺手治：病句错字改掉，「倒吸一口凉气」这种用烂的梗直接改写；打斗太干瘪就开扩写，补的是画面感，不是字数。语言不是障碍：生肉整本翻好，日轻丢掉的「谁在说话」给你补上，嫌不够就加一句自己的规矩——诗词留不留它照办。书从哪来都行：TXT 直接拖，或者甩个书名、链接、几个关键词，它自己上网找。正经阅读器伺候：11 套主题，字号、字距、行距、段距全可调，目录、书签、沉浸模式一个不少，读到哪自动记住，章节随时导出。

Yours to host: Autai runs on your machine and serves its full interface to any browser on your network — desktop, phone, or tablet — with a mobile layout and optional password sign-in. Your keys, your conversations, your books: all local.
自己 host：Autai 跑在你自己的机器上，完整界面开给全网浏览器——手机、平板、电脑，专门的手机排版，可设密码登录。你的 Key、你的对话、你的书，全在本地。

225+ 家服务商、8000+ 个模型——自带 Key，自建 / 本地 API 也认，随时切
